title: Account for impairment of property, plant, and equipment

items.concept: Recoverability → impairment initial recognition; subsequent multi-year depreciation schedule on new cost basis; period-end dep JE; disposal after impairment
Number-variant twin — recoverability, impairment JE, subsequent measurement schedule, period-end dep JE, disposal
Period-end multi-asset recoverability (pass vs fail); combined impairment JE; subsequent measurement schedule with residual on written-down asset
Recoverability uses undiscounted cash flows; impairment loss measured with fair value
New cost basis after impairment; no restoration; subsequent depreciation
